name: github-actions-docs
title: GitHub Actions Docs
description: Look up GitHub Actions documentation and patterns while building workflows.

details.whatItDoes: Answers GitHub Actions questions using relevant official documentation rather than relying on remembered workflow patterns.
details.whenToUse: Use it for workflow syntax, runners, caching, reusable workflows, or documentation-grounded Actions explanations.
details.whenNotToUse: Do not use it to triage a specific failed PR check, manage repository branches, or configure CodeQL or Dependabot; the source routes those tasks elsewhere.
details.exampleTask: Explain reusable workflows versus composite actions for a demo repository, with exact GitHub documentation links.

name: git-commit
title: Git Commit
description: Review repository changes and make focused commits with clear, conventional commit messages.

details.whatItDoes: Examines the diff, stages related files, writes a Conventional Commits message, and creates a Git commit.
details.whenToUse: Use it when you want to commit repository changes or split them into focused commits.
details.whenNotToUse: Do not use it for a message-only request, pushing, opening pull requests, rebasing, or changing commit history. It stages files and creates commits.
details.exampleTask: Review the demo catalog changes and make a focused conventional commit without pushing.

name: azure-deployment-preflight
title: Azure Deployment Preflight
description: Validate Bicep deployments before they run: template checks, what-if previews and permission checks for az and azd.

details.whatItDoes: Checks Bicep syntax, previews Azure resource changes, and reports deployment issues and permission-check results before provisioning.
details.whenToUse: Use it before a Bicep deployment through az or azd when you want to understand planned changes and validation gaps.
details.whenNotToUse: Do not treat the report as a deployment or a guarantee of success. Missing Azure tools, access, or permissions can leave checks incomplete.
details.exampleTask: Validate the demo infrastructure Bicep and report planned resource changes before provisioning.

name: documentation-writer
title: Documentation Writer
description: Turn code and rough notes into practical documentation for engineers.

details.whatItDoes: Creates software documentation organized as tutorials, how-to guides, reference, or explanation using the Diataxis framework.
details.whenToUse: Use it when you can clarify the audience, goal, scope, and document type, then approve an outline before drafting.
details.whenNotToUse: Avoid it when you want an immediate draft without discussion. Do not expect external research unless you provide links and explicitly request it.
details.exampleTask: Prepare an outline for a newcomer how-to guide to browsing this demo skill catalog.
